QuestInfo.name: Reclaiming the Relic
QuestInfo.0: Tell #p3000000# about what you heard from #p3000001#. You must reclaim the relic!
QuestInfo.1: #p3000000# says the patrol found the entrance to the Nefarious Priests's hideout at #b#m400010300##k. Go to the hideout, defeat the Nefarious Priests, and reclaim the relic. You can find it on\r\n#r#o2400008# or\r\n#o2400009##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've returned with the relic, and #p3000000# quickly delivered it to #p3000001#. Will the Protective Shield be restored now?

0.0: Good to have you here. Our patrol just discovered the possible entrance to the enemy hideout. By the way, what did #p3000001# tell you?\r\n#L0##b#p3000001# said we have to get that Relic back pronto.#l\n#k
0.1: We found the hideout, so the Relic should be there too. We'll show those Nefarious Priests!

yes.0: Good. Come with us. While we draw their attention, you should sneak in and reclaim the Relic. Head to #b#m400010300##k and find it.

no.0: Is there anything more important than reclaiming the Relic?

yes.0: Yes! None can stand before my massive power. I better get this back to #p3000001#.

item.0: We don't have time for this. Go through the hidden entrance at #m400010300# and investigate the enemy hideout. Maybe #r#o2400008# or #o2400009##k has the Relic.
